registered_workload: Compute cyclomatic complexity for the first 1800 sorted Python files in the fixed experiment environment and return the same JSON result.
correctness_requirements: The original project tests must pass.
The parsed JSON result must equal the serial result.
The command-line entry point and supported options must keep working.
Result order or JSON text formatting may differ only when parsed content is equal.
constraints: Use only existing dependencies or the Python standard library.
Do not change the registered workload adapter.
Do not hard-code the benchmark input paths.
The final claim is based on end-to-end runtime, not a microbenchmark.
